findings.summary: StratifiedKFold splits at the visit level and ignores patient_id, so one patient's visits can fall in both train and test folds, leaking data and inflating the reported PR-AUC; use StratifiedGroupKFold/GroupKFold with groups=df["patient_id"].

judge.reason: Same defect: row-level StratifiedKFold lets a patient's visits span train and test; suggests grouping by patient_id.

findings.label: hit
